texts.zh:
当我们的船进入[From.GetName]星系时，显而易见的是有奇怪的事正在发生。这个星系的其中一个星球拥有着引人注目的卫星数量，而这颗星球似乎曾经适宜居住但现在却显示出相当高的辐射读数。另一个星球被完全摧毁了。碎片散落在整个系统中，表明这里曾经生活过的任何文明都在一场激烈的斗争中被毁灭了。

一艘战舰在星系中巡逻。它不响应我们的问询，而且它的航线表明其正在拦截[Root.GetName]。它的武器系统正在充能。
texts.en:
As our ships enter the [From.GetName] system, it is immediately obvious that something very strange happened here. One of the planets - which boasts an eye-catching distribution of moons - appears to have once been habitable, but initial scans show high levels of radiation. Another planet has been totally destroyed. Debris is scattered across the system, suggesting that whatever civilization once lived here was obliterated in a violent struggle.

A battleship patrols the system. It is not responding to our hails, and it's set on an intercept course for the [Root.GetName], its weapons systems charging up.

# 卫星过多的恒星系 / The Too-Many-Moons System
- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7) · 星系事件 system event

## 如何开始 How it starts

玩家的舰队首次进入带有 planet_with_too_many_moons_system 星标、且系统中有 too_many_moons_warder 舰队的星系时，on_entering_system_first_time（`00_on_actions.txt:908`）触发；仅对非AI玩家。/ Fired by on_entering_system_first_time when a human player first enters a system flagged planet_with_too_many_moons_system with a too_many_moons_warder fleet.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

**[星系名] 星系（20）**：一个“卫星过多”的星系看守者出现，单一选项“全员战斗岗位！”。/ The warder of the system with too many moons appears; the only option is “Battle stations!”.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

单事件。/ A single event.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

仅限非AI玩家。/ Human players only.
